analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read occurs because ValidateListArray unconditionally calls array.value_offset(array.length()), and BaseListArray::value_offset indexes raw_value_offsets_[i + data_->offset]. ValidateOffsets() computes required offset buffer entries as (length > 0) ? length + offset + 1 : 0, so for a sliced/offset list array with length == 0 it allows too-small offset buffers and does not require offset+1 entries. Then value_offset(0) reads past the provided offsets buffer.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In the IPC stream fuzz path (ipc::internal::FuzzIpcStream -> RecordBatch::ValidateFull -> ValidateArray -> ValidateListArray), attacker-controlled IPC metadata must produce a ListArray/LargeListArray with nonzero array offset and zero length (or otherwise insufficient offsets for i=length at current offset). ValidateOffsets passes due to its length==0 special case, then ValidateListArray reads first/last offsets via value_offset(0)/value_offset(length), triggering the OOB read.
